text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Saddam Huessein meets with chairman and senior staff of the Iraqi Atomic Energy Organisation.
- Deputy Prime Minister Tareq Aziz meets in New York with foreign ministers of France and Italy.
- Three shiploads of food bought under the oil-for-food deal with the U.N. arrive in Um Qasr port in southern Iraq.
- Iraqi Oil Minister Amir Muhammad Rasheed arrives in Spain.
